confirmedFindings.title: Unsorted Array Search Replaces Longest Prefix Match
confirmedFindings.body: Searching an unsorted rate table with Array.find returns the first arbitrary matching prefix (e.g. '+1' US general) rather than the most specific longest prefix (e.g. '+1415' San Francisco premium), resulting in severe tariff calculation errors.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Sort rate entries by prefix length descending or utilize an E.164 Radix Trie.
